facts.business: Sai Silks Kalamandir Limited operates as a multi-brand ethnic wear retailer in South India with a portfolio of five distinct brands (Kalamandir, Mandir, Varamahalakshmi Silks, Valli Silks, and KLM Fashion Mall) across 81 stores following a Company-Owned Company-Operated (COCO) model.

capacity_or_capex.item: Store expansion - 14 new stores opened in FY 2025-26

guidance_or_targets.statement: We expect the trend to continue in the ensuing years and reward our stakeholders in a better manner

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on Note no. 38,39 regarding trade receivables and trade payables subject to confirmation/reconciliation and consequential adjustment

key_risks: Inventory obsolescence risk due to long holding periods
Trade receivables and payables subject to confirmation/reconciliation
Dependence on South India market concentration
facts.related_party_note: Personal guarantees provided by promoter NAGA KANAKA DURGA PRASAD CHALAVADI for bank borrowings
